notes.title: Best death patch (26/08/22).
notes.notes:
Hey!

It's been a while right?!
I had a player reporting an issue with the Best Death stat as he was trying to complete the whole game deathless.

The best death stat was not updating if the best time was not beaten. My bad, this patch should solve the issue, now these two stats are independent and should be saved as expected.

Thanks to レツ for finding this bug!!

Michael.

notes.title: Canon inputs update.
notes.notes:
Heya!

This is a tiny update adding a new setting to the way you can control the canons with the mouse.
Before, you could center the cursor on the canon upon activation, then aim by moving the mouse around it. Or you could pre-aim the canon with your mouse cursor on the screen, and this was still relative to the canon location. 
I have added a new setting so you can pre-aim with the cursor on the screen, but this time based on the center of the screen. This means you can pre-aim, and this will not be based on the canon screen-space location, but based on the screen center.
The on-screen aiming had an issue, if the camera was moving upon canon activation, your aiming was changing. With the new setting, the camera or the canon position won't affect your aiming, because it's based on the center of the screen (the center of the screen represent the center of the canon).
You'll have to experiment with the best setting for you.

I have added an on-screen "star" upon canon activation, so you can see roughly the angle at which you are aiming.

Feel free to give me feedback on this as I personally play with a gamepad.

See you soon!

Michael.

notes.title: Tiny Update
notes.notes:
Hello!

A quick update to fix an issue with the checkpoint's best times. Using the level quick restart right after a checkpoint was messing up the order the checkpoints were recorded. This is now fixed!
In case you think one of the times in your checkpoint list is looking suspicious, or if you have experienced the bug, you can press Control+R at the beginning of the level (Before pressing starting the level). This will delete all your checkpoint times for this level, allowing you to start fresh.


I have also moved a bit down a hitbox below the flippers, in some cases, the ball was touching it and was being killed for no real reason (unfair!). This adjustment should fix the issue, but if you experience this bug after this update, please let me know.

And that's it for now! Be sure to check your ranking in the new leaderboards (Normal mode, B-Roll mode, and Full-Game mode).

Also, not that I care too much, but you can nominate the game for the Steam Awards, you can choose whatever you want :)
And a little reminder that a positive review on the store page is mega helpful, I would really appreciate it if you take the time to post one <3


Thanks a lot!


Michael.

notes.title: Speedy Update!
notes.notes:
Hola!

I hope everyone is doing well!
I know it has been a long time, I needed a break from Super High Ball dev. Anyway!

I have added 3 new leaderboards to the game, you can now see your ranking for the completion of the Normal Mode, the B-Roll Mode, and the Full-Game!
These are visible from the "progression screen => Leaderboard".
I am displaying your times, only if you have completed the modes, but nothing stops you from checking the leaderboard.

Your times and deaths will be uploaded when the game starts, so the only thing you have to do, is to launch the game, head to the progression screen, and see how good you're doing! I mean, if you have completed the modes of course :)
That's it for now!

See you soon.

Michael.

It adds a per checkpoint personal best time!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37653187/b9405c32d9d047d69553c84db616f3f3968501d7.png

I could do a long blog post to explain how it works, but it's quite straightforward. The only thing I want to highlight, is the best time per checkpoint was not recorded before this update, meaning that even if you have played a level, you won't have any data to display. So you will have to play the level again to populate your save file.

Hope you like this little addition!

See you soon :)

notes.title: October Patch!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Yeah still updating the game I know. While I was on holiday, got a few bug reports from users so I decided to quickly fix them so I can carry on working on what I wanted to add to the game.

There was an issue with the resetting of some assets when using the "press A to respawn" option (The thing that waits for your input after each death). 
Well, this is now fixed!

I was previously saving the achievements progress with a save file "ach.sav", the game was checking if the achievement was unlocked, and if not, it was sending the unlock command to Steam. I had a few reports from a few players where achievements were not unlocking, this was probably coming from a miss connection with Steam at the moment I send the instruction, and because the achievement unlock was saved on the file, the player couldn't unlock it again.
Anyway, I am not checking this file anymore before sending the instruction to Steam, so hopefully, players having issues with achievements will not be blocked by this bug anymore.
Very difficult to test on my side, so if you still got issues, please let me know!

Have a great Friday! I'll go back to work on some new things for the game :)


Michael.

notes.title: Release Patch 11 (The frustration patch!)
notes.notes:
Hi!

How is everyone doing?

After watching some people playing Super High Ball, and having some feedback from a few players, I have decided to find a way to make the game less frustrating.

The main element that was mentioned, was the lasers. They were always activated after a respawn, making the player slow down and wait to carry on, so every time you died, you had to wait for the lasers to stop again.

The lasers will not be activated after a respawn (in most cases), I have shifted their timing so their activation is delayed, allowing you to pass straight after a respawn.
I took this opportunity to reduce their activation time, some of them were activated for 1 second, I have reduced that for all the lasers. The maximum activation time is around 0.5 seconds. I hope this helps to reduce the time you have to wait to be able to continue.
This means the times in the leaderboard or the times to beat should be easier to beat!

-------------------------

Fixes and changes:
Fixed a collision on level 22 (Normal and B-Roll).
Some tiny adjustments in the last levels (added some CP, removed some lasers, removed some red circles).
Added LODs for the geometry and material of the aiming canon.
Rebuilt the lighting and reflection in the highest quality (might not be visible, but it's good practice to do).


That's it for today! I hope this helps to make Super High Ball better. If you think about one particular aspect of the game that could be adjusted/changed to reduce the difficulty or the frustration, please let me know!

Many thanks!

Michael.

notes.title: Release Patch 10
notes.notes:
Hi!

Your daily dose of patching is here!

More optimization:
Added material LODs for expensive materials. (Switching between translucent to masked, should reduce the draw calls on the GPU).
Added LODs for more geometries. (Fewer polygons when the camera is far).
Fixed the red circle collision which was affecting the ball trajectory on some instances (Thanks Matthew for finding this one!).

The gamepad L-Stick needs to be pushed at least at 50% for the canon to rotate, this is to prevent very sensitive sticks from rotating the canon. (Need to be confirmed by Clovinoux).

Added the shortcut achievement trigger to another cave level.

That's it for now!

The canon's previews are now colliding with the pads and bridges, they should also be a tiny bit more acurate.

notes.title: Release Patch 08
notes.notes:
Hello!

And yes! Another update! Let's goooo!

Levels:
Some tiny adjustments in the Cliff and Volcano B-Roll levels, mainly one difficult session has been changed, and some other sessions were bringing tiny issues.
A tiny bit of camera fix.

General fixes:
The zone unlocks animation was being played in B-Roll after finishing the Normal Mode, every time! (hopefully fixed!).

Optimizations:
Reduced level geometry for each Cliff level (-30% polygons). (better for GPU and CPU)
Added mip-maps for most of the assets. (better for GPU according to the Unreal Engine documentation).
Removed tick for most assets (these were unnecessary ticking on every frame). (better for CPU)
Simplified some materials. (better for GPU)
Default resolution when starting the game for the first time set to 1920x1080. (Sorry for the players with an 8K screen... the game was starting at the maximal resolution supported by the monitor, oopsie).

Some assets might look less sharp/defined due to the textures mip-mapping. I like things sharp, but if this helps to get better performances, well I'll take it. You're V-Ram should feel better, but I couldn't measure how much exactly.

I'll carry on with optimization for the Volcano and Peak levels.

Bye!

notes.title: Release Patch 06
notes.notes:
Heya!

I hope everyone is having a nice weekend (if you read this during the weekend)!

I have made some tiny changes on some levels:

 A hole in level 24 was not really a hole and had a collision issue.
 Removed some laser walls in level 24, hopefully preventing from blocking the player.
 The Kubos in Tutorial 01 B-Roll is easier to catch.


Some fixes:

 Removed patch notes on the main menu.
 Fixed the leaderboard icons, they should update and refresh properly.
 Fixed the AA setting in Low, this was looking horrible in the B-Roll world map, it should be better now.
 Reduced even more the death screen flash.
 It was very difficult to get a vertical shot using the keyboard while running the game at 165 FPS. So I have added a tiny animation to the flippers mimicking the analog from the gamepad triggers. This is not visible, but the physics engine recognizes it and this fixes the issue.


Now the tricky part, I am trying to mitigate the physics tick rate variations (having a fixed tick rate no matter what is the FPS count).
This is not possible with Unreal, I could use a bullet solver like Rocker League, but that requires a lot of development, a proper dev to change the source code, and most importantly, this will change the physics of the game, and that is the part that I don't want to touch too much as I'm happy with how it is.

What I can do is reduce the variations as much as I can:

 Locked the max FPS to 120 instead of 165, sadly I have to do this so the gap is reduced.
 Checked "Enhanced Determinism" in the project settings. This is a setting that was not existing in the previous Unreal versions, sounds like what I needed, but the doc says it just tries to improve the physics determinism, it does not fix it.



I'm playing around a fine balance where the physics breaks if I touch too many settings, this is scary tbh, so I hope this helps (without breaking the game).
I am now going to focus on the camera. There are some instances where the camera doesn't follow the ball, and that's an issue!

Thanks to the players who have reviewed the game, I now have a "Positive" score! (Steam needed 10 reviews to be able to display this on the Store Page).

See you in the next patch!!

Michael.

Another update!

 Scaled a tiny bit the lava kill box, no more swimming in the lava!

I'm trying some things to see if I can get a more constant and stable physics tick-rate. Unreal does not allow a fixed tick rate, but there are some settings that I can change to get closer.

I am still investigating the proper way to rotate the whole game so it can be played natively on pinball cabinets, once again, Unreal does not allow that if the game is not played on mobile... But I'll keep digging!

For now, the amazing Solters has done a nice guide to show you how he is doing!
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2519165148

Hi!

I have added a new setting in the "Keyboard Mapping" screen that allows you to turn on or off the use of the mouse cursor to drive the blue canons.
It is on by default and should only work when you are using the keyboard (should switch off if you are using a controller).
You can disable the feature and use left and right flippers to rotate the canons.

Additionally, I have bound the mouse buttons to the flippers by default, you can still use the shift keys or any other custom keys, but the mouse buttons will always be bound to the flippers.

This way you can use your left hand for other controls, and your right hand for flippers and canons.

I really hope this helps keyboard/mouse players in their progress and it should be easier to complete the levels!

notes.title: The B-Roll Update
notes.notes:
Hello fellow Pinball Platformers! How have you been?
I know it has been a while since I have pushed an update for the game, it's because this one is a BIG one! So let's go!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37653187/00155ee87578ffa570894ec2a7f7e7c9bd3f59e4.png

This update brings 28 new levels! New? Well yes and no... These new levels are a copy of their normal version, the same starting point, the same finish line (see this as the B-Sides in Celest).
But I have added much more traps, changed the "layout", and I have added new mechanics!

Walls of Cubes:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37653187/d92586e56240751369d5069ecdb158a3791e1cee.png

I have placed these cubes a bit everywhere, they act as platforms, or as walls. Some of them can be destroyed by hitting a button that will be placed on tough spots that will force you to be more precise when you kick the ball.

Tracking Canons:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37653187/43bf72c088797946ed5b634e39f9d0f5f7513365.png

These ones will for sure affect your sanity! Pass in front of them, and they will start to track you, at this point, your only option is to hide behind a wall, or a flipper! 
After 2.2 seconds, it will shoot at you and instantly destroy the ball!

Ghosts:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37653187/c0d09a672a6534d098c47b63b05b6f2a0ef845b1.png

Look at these lovely guys! They will follow you because they love you! But they might want to get too close, way too close! These ghosts will push the ball or even destroy it if they squeeze it against a wall. 
But they can also help! Climbing a wall when you are a ball sounds impossible, find a ghost, and let him bring you higher! Just don't forget to pass through his home to remove the curse.

Winds:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37653187/648a783fe355c07bb4a92d67881b3043d75fd7fa.png

And finally, how can I, as a developer, make your "rolling" more interesting? Wind!
Wind going up, wind going down, wind going left and right, or even in diagonal! You will have to anticipate the change of velocity if you don't want to end up in the fire.


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37653187/a4f0cde76c1585859579dcd3206f5add3644c7c6.png


Now let's talk a bit more about the B-Roll mode and why it took so long to make.
I wanted a real change in the look for these levels, I hope you'll find it interesting!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37653187/4e36d603c66eb5596caf87ab8b0e7cdc3b07b6c2.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37653187/71ee63a59e1c248fef7311e3288fec778aec9aa3.png

To access the B-Roll version of a world, you'll have to complete its normal version. It is recommended to progress through the game before tackling the B-Roll mode. Some late-game mechanics are used in early levels in this mode, you might hit a wall of difficulty if you jump straight into it.

Obviously, new levels mean new goals and so new customizations! Actually one new goal. In this mode, there is no more "Death Goal". Instead, you will have to collect a "Kubos" and finish the level to unlock the "Kubos Goal". The Kubos are placed in each level, in a difficult spot, requiring you to take risks to collect them, if you catch one and pass the following checkpoint, good job you have secured the catch, but if you die before the checkpoint, you'll have to collect it again!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37653187/b22198198c1d86a759b04c0db47ba354e562cf0b.png


Let's talk about customizations. You'll collect Cubes instead of Balls in the B-Roll mode. Use these to unlock new skins for your Flippers, your Death Mark or your Leaderboard Icon!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37653187/664b99a39284dcb7a393de8b302618c1aed46191.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37653187/b67573b5358819e344c82d876463bbc0de4fc415.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37653187/cef76fdbce7438253d38605891ede7255109a724.png

Yes! An icon for the leaderboard! Show the world your progress through the B-Roll world! 
Talking about the leaderboard, it now displays the number of deaths you did when submitting your best time (you'll have to replay the level to update your entry).

What's more? Well a lot, so I'll just talk about the biggest changes.


 There is now a global progression screen, accessible from the main menu. You can track your progress for each level, the total amount of attempts, number of wins, deaths or playtime etc...
 I have removed the accessibility setting that allowed you to slow down the game when the camera was moving too fast. I have replaced it with two settings.
 The first one, allows you to enable or disable a message that will be displayed if you die too many times during a run, This message will offer you to slow down the game by 30% until you reach the next checkpoint. The option is on by default, but you can turn it off if you want.
 The second setting allows you to run the game at 70% of its original speed, allowing players that are struggling to progress through the game. Don't worry, the timer is also running slower, so there is no penalty for using this setting. This is why it's called "accessibility" and not "cheat".
 I have added more colours for the flippers, you can change these from the game settings.
 There are now 38 new Achievements, related to the B-Roll mode but not only.



The tiny changes that you won't notice, but if you are curious:

UI work, game introduction, lighting optimizations, geometry optimizations, texture optimizations, proper FPS counter, post-processing optimizations, Gravity Void has a new look, fixed some cameras and some flippers, added a little pause after each death, fixed a tiny bug with the blue canons, increased death goals, added some more feedback on the bouncers and impulses, added some indications for the Gravity Void, improved goal animation, added an overview of the goals on the level introduction, slowed down the camera movement for each level introductions, and more super tiny changes!


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



I really hope you will enjoy this update, it took me a lot of time, and I hope I have answered most of the requests from the community. 
I know I could add so much more to the game, but 2021 marks the seventh year of development! And I have to admit I would like to move on, you know, seven years!!
I am still not 100% sure, but I think this will be the last content update I bring to the game, the community has proposed some very cool ideas, that could be very fun to add, so I might, much later, add these to the game (for free, I do not plan to add any DLC to the game).

So for now, I consider Super High Ball completed! I'll obviously continue to update the game from times to times, by fixing bugs or polishing some aspect of the game. I'm still considering adding various languages localization and another set of accessibility settings.
This means I need to prepare for release!

That's it! Thanks a lot if you have read everything! 

A very warm thanks to those who have added a review on the store page, it is very important to bring Super High Ball in front of potential new players, the more "positive" reviews, the more the game will appear in front of Steam users. Also a mega thanks to the members of the community who has been tracking bugs, and made suggestions!

Stay safe, and see you soon!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37653187/4741a879218d67b48fff65c4ade10189a810a034.png

notes.title: Update v0.8.7 (08/02/21).
notes.notes:
Hi!

Thanks to the community feedback, I have been able to improve Super High Ball, and made it less frustrating when it comes to goal hunting. This update also includes some look improvements and a new pass of optimizations! You can also view the patch note from the main menu by pressing Y/Triangle/Tab.



Game changes:
* Thanks to the community for their feedback, the game should now offer a better progression regarding goal rewards!
* The deathless goal is no more, now, each level has a different death limit.
* The time to beat goal is now much easier to get. Each level has three times, Gold, Platinum and Diamond. Beating the Gold time will grant you the reward, Platinum and Diamond are here to motivate you to beat them, but won't reward you anything except satisfaction (Take a screenshot to show your friends your achievement!).
* You might have to replay the levels to unlock the goals,  sorry for that. Just finishing the level should update your goal rewards.

Smaller changes and Optimization:
* Added the option to slow the time when the camera moves from one place to another during gameplay. This should help players anticipate the next screen, although it is recommended to play without this setting for the best experience. (Work in progress)
* The camera will pull out when the ball is too close to the screen borders.
* Some UI tweaks. Material icons in the ball customization are now gold color when they are available to use.
* Added extra on-screen checkpoint dots to fit the number of checkpoints in the Peak world.
* New banner when the level intro is playing, showing goals requirements and progression.
* Lighting optimization for various assets, reducing the number of lights during gameplay.
* New shading for every level, adding more shine and making the levels more interesting to see.
* Added the ability to rebind the keyboard keys for menu navigation.
* Removed the ability to have limitless frame-rate, limiting it to 165 FPS. This was causing issues when the frame-rate was varying too much during gameplay.
* Fixed some asset animations that were bound by the frame-rate. This should make most of the game moves the same at 60 or 165 FPS. Ball physic remains unchanged.
* Some particles optimization.
* World map optimization (removed a very heavy geometry and replaced it with shader work).
* Removed Occulus VR and Steam VR plugins from the engine, this should fix the VR popups when launching the game.
* Ball reflection optimization. Also, the setting to disable the realtime reflection should improve performances.
* Adjusted some ball materials. The color should now be displayed properly.


That's it for now, this has been a difficult one for me, but I'm happy how the game is now!
Many thanks for playing Super High Ball, as a solo developer, seeing peoples playing my game makes me the happiest man on earth. If you like the game, even if it's not perfect, please consider leaving a nice review on the game store page, this will help a lot to bring Super High Ball in front of potential new players.

If you are facing any issues with the game, or if you would like to get in touch to chat about it, please join the conversation in the forums of the game!

Enjoy!

Michael.

notes.title: The Peak Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37653187/3c5cff65105e97d3cbea2d4b3bf3c54114c3b837.png


Hello fellow players!
I hope everyone is doing well, counting the days left until 2020 is behind us!
I know this update comes a bit late, but I had to face many challenges, not only game development, but it was a busy time for me! Anyway, let's get started:

Most of my time has been focused on defining and making the levels of the peak world, as you can see, they are quite different from the other worlds!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37653187/a26e84d964bdd4271f1bb76c74f6e1549840cc58.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37653187/4cf040123ee2d8a9dc51192bb039941941745d7a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37653187/3c57ddb3a420e2b75553b02109c2d1b63eeee20c.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37653187/0eb7e6cc560dec8fe4b407056a04708160241d69.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37653187/012fd01f2ca801eff5c1f7fa10f6808b12edc2e9.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37653187/74012ff78fac80afc6a542ec1db0fa2fd197ea3a.png

I really hope you like the look of these levels! A lot of time went into it.



Let's carry on with a major update for the game, I moved the project from Unreal 4.22 to 4.25. sounds like an easy step? Nope, Unreal has a completely new lighting code and many things were broken after the transition, and once I've fixed everything, I ran into many performances issues, mainly bad frame rate... But now it's done, if you see any major performances issues, please let me know in the forums and I can have a look.
One graphic feature you'll notice is the new depth of field, it's much nicer! But the lasers do not cast lighting anymore, this was taking a lot of GPU ressources, so I removed the lights and put decals instead. It's not as nice, but it's nicer for your GPU.

I have also optimized the UI animation, allowing me to iterate faster without breaking everything. You can already see some tiny changes here and there, and I'll carry on working on the UI. Something I did finally update is the UI for the timer and death count, it's... nicer I think.

Moving on!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37653187/ed96fef996324809548a786eb64d1b4d0ce66fd3.png

The new levels come with a new game mechanic, as usual, it's not here to help you!
The bridges are holes in the level, that you need to fill by hitting the activator! Some bridges are already filled and will be destroyed after you pass them, some bridges will collapse after a few seconds, some bridges will remain activated. I hope you like it, it forces you to be a bit more precise and add some tension! oulala!

So that's it for the content update, you can now reach the top (there is nothing special about this, for now). This concludes the main ascension, 28 levels, 84 golden balls! Plenty of deaths!



The next step is adding the B-Roll mode, which is the Hard Mode! You can see I have added a mode switcher from the world selection (Press X/Square/Alt) !
There will be 28 levels for the B-Roll mode, and new things to unlock (no more balls, but cubes, very original I know), but this is all work in progress so I won't talk too much about it! I still need to think about what these cubes will allow you to customize.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37653187/b094b62860fbfd9ac04b43ac4b04ba97b06c25a1.png

As always, feel free to reach out, for support, questions or issues, keep fighting for the leaderboard and most importantly, have an amazing Christmas time and stay safe!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37653187/e5422ab5fafb54c18efce935c44b7f6050a7e952.png

Michael.

notes.title: Update (17/10/20) - 0.4.7
notes.notes:
Hello!

A small update adding the first pass on the player statistics.

The game now records every time you attempt a level, or complete it, the time spent playing it and the number of times you died.

This is a per-level statistic, this should help you track how much efforts you put into each level.
From the level selection, you will see some new things. A bit of design update, and you can now press Y/triangle/Tab to switch between displaying the level map, or the level stats. This means you cannot hide the UI in the level selection, but I think it was a bit useless.

The total time played starts when the timer starts, it is paused when the game is paused, and stop when you reach the end of the level or if you restart/quit the level.
The death count increase for each death, even the ones before the first checkpoint.
The total attempt increase when you start the level, restart it or reset it during gameplay.
The total completed count increase only when you finish the level.

The stats won't be saved if you Alt+F4 the game, but you know, you shouldn't do that!

This is a first pass on the stats, I'm planning to add the ability to display global stats, showing the global playtime, death etc... But I need to find out where this information will be displayed. At least from now, your stats will be updated as you play, unfortunately, if you have played before this update, the stats won't reflect your own experience, 

That's it for this week! Thanks for playing, keep fighting for the leaderboard first place (good luck).



Michael.

notes.title: Update (16/10/20) - 0.4.5
notes.notes:
Heya!

Here is a little update adding some features proposed by the community.

1/ Frame Rate Limit Unlock:
I have added the ability to unlock the frame rate. Go to the setting screen, then in Graphics, you will find the new setting there, 
Unlocking the frame rate will disable the V-Sync (which is capping the FPS to 60).
Enabling the V-Sync will Lock the FPS back to 60.
If you are in the main menu or on the level selection, you might not see any differences, but once in-game it will work.

I have been able to reach 120 FPS with max settings, and in 4K (on an RTX 2070).

You might feel like the camera movement is faster in this mode, let me know if it's an issue and I'll find a way to fix it. The ball physic and gameplay shouldn't be affected by the FPS difference,

2/ No CheckPoint mode:
From the level introduction screen, you can now press Y/Triangle/Tab, to disable the checkpoint on the level, allowing you to try-hard from the start to the end of the level, enjoy!
I took this opportunity to redesign the intro screen, by removing the "B to go Back" line, you can still go back to the level selection by pressing B/Circle/Escape, but I am not displaying this anymore.


That's all for now! Thanks for playing as usual! 
Please use the forums to report bugs and give your thoughts.

Game version: Early Access 0.4.5

Michael.

notes.title: Update (16/06/20)
notes.notes:
Hello!

I hope everyone is home and safe! And enjoying the weather.

In the last week, I have been working with Whiler, a very nice guy, who helped me create a new leaderboard for Super High Ball!

Previously I was using Playfab services to store the data related to the leaderboard. It's API was the best regarding free leaderboard in Unreal Engine. Did I say free? Yeah, it's free until a certain point! You can have 25 different leaderboards before having to pay to unlock more. And the price was way too high for an indie developer (99$/month). The issue is, I needed more than 25 leaderboards! Right now I have only 13 levels, but that is going to change! Anyway, Whiler has been working really hard to host a leaderboard on my own server and did some nice script that I have used in Unreal!

What does it mean?

I am free from Playfab, means I do not collect any localisation information! Please read the new EULA to know more about this,
The leaderboard is actually faster to update, so your Rank at the end of a level will show faster!
We will be able to block cheaters! Forever :) Even if I haven't seen one yet.
The players from the Demo, are now sharing the same leaderboards as the players from the Full Game, nice :)

I have also reduced the volume of the music, it might be to low now, so I might bring it back up a bit, or pull down the SFX volumes. Probably in a future update.
The card on the menu screen of the Demo is now responding nicely to screen sizes.

And many tiny fixes that you won't notice.

Now I'll be back to do some new levels and adding new mechanics!


Enjoy, stay safe and see you soon!


Michael.

Also, if you have not noticed yet, I have added a Free Demo of Super High Ball! Tell your friends!


What are you working on?

I know you are waiting for more content, and I am working on it! It took me a bit of time to go around my setup to make levels, it's not an easy one! But after some days of work, I have simplified my workflow, and now I have feedback on what players like or not, it's easier for me to make new levels.
I'm working on the 5 levels of the Cliff Zone, and this should come in a few weeks.

This new Zone will bring new challenges! The ground will be cracked open at some points, so don't fall!
A new asset will appear, I call it a sand zone, but it looks like a hell hole right now. If your ball goes into it, it will slow down, similar to the ball slow power, but this time you don't control it! It will bring you into holes, fires, and will hold your ball right where a laser beam is!
I will try to bring some creative obstacles that use the paddles, similar to some parts in the Cave Zone.


Hope you are excited! And thanks for playing the game!
